name: Hilkiah (High Priest under Josiah)
title: High Priest who found the Book of the Law
summary: Hilkiah was the high priest in Jerusalem during King Josiah's reign. He is best known for finding the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord during temple renovations, a discovery that led to Josiah's great religious reform and renewal of the covenant with God.

keyEvents.title: Finds the Book of the Law in the temple
keyEvents.description: During the renovation of the temple, Hilkiah found the Book of the Law (likely Deuteronomy) and gave it to the scribe Shaphan. This discovery became a turning point in Judah's religious history.

keyEvents.title: Sends the Book of the Law to the king
keyEvents.description: Hilkiah handed over the Book of the Law to Shaphan, who read it to King Josiah. The king was deeply moved by its content and tore his clothes.

keyEvents.title: Consults the prophetess Huldah
keyEvents.description: King Josiah sent Hilkiah along with other leaders to the prophetess Huldah to ask the Lord about the words of the Book of the Law and the judgment that had been warned over the people.

keyEvents.title: Participates in Covenant Renewal
keyEvents.description: Hilkiah was present when King Josiah read the Book of the Law to all the people and renewed the covenant with the Lord at the temple.

keyEvents.title: Purifies the Temple from Idolatry
keyEvents.description: Josiah commanded Hilkiah and the other priests to remove all idolatrous objects from the house of the Lord, including vessels made for Baal and Asherah.
